summary:
Iter 46 — Paddle raise, sponsor logos, morning-after gala thank-you, and silent auction. Backend: 5/5 pytests PASS (TestPaddle, TestSponsors, TestThanks, TestAuction, TestRegression). Frontend: all data-testids verified on EmceeControl (/admin/gala/{eid}/emcee, 390px), GalaScreen (/gala/{eid}, 1920px), GalaExtras (admin > Events > Sell tickets panel), AuctionAdmin (/admin/auction/{eid}), and Auction public (/auction/{eid}, 390px). Paddle flow: PUT /paddle level=500 → GET returns level 500; posting 2 pledges yields tally [{500,2}] total 1000 and GET /api/gala/{eid} raised=1000, paddle.level=500, paddle.total=1000; undo removes one (total 500); collected toggle flips the flag; PUT level=null hides; invalid level 0 → 400; bad-email pledge → 400. Sponsors: multipart upload (QA Sponsor, table 2) returned id/name/table/logo, appears in GET /api/gala/{eid}.sponsors AND GET /api/admin/events/{eid}/seating.sponsors; delete removes it; a non-image upload → 400. Thanks: GET /gala-thanks → recipients>=1 and html contains 'Thank you'; PUT enabled:false persists via subsequent GET; subprocess call to server._gala_thanks(now = event.date+1d 10:00 ET) sent N1>=1 emails, second call returned 0 (push_marks dedupe), with gala_thanks:False a third call (after clearing marker) returned 0. Auction: item start=50 raise=10; bidding before open → 400 'Bidding is closed'; PUT closes_at past → 400; PUT closes_at='2099-12-12T20:00' → state 'open'; register missing phone → 400, same email re-register returns identical token; bid 40 → 400, bid 50 ok, same bidder re-bid → 400 'You're already the highest bidder'; second bidder bid 55 → 400 (min 60), bid 60 ok; first bidder GET /auction/{eid}?token sees outbid:true/mine:false, second sees mine:true; DELETE item with bids → 400; POST close → winners=1 and 1 auction_wins row; GET /auction/pay/{tok} unpaid; POST pay returns Stripe test checkout url (sess.id persisted); subprocess server._auction_paid(session_id) flipped status to paid; bidding after close → 400; CSV download text/csv and contains 'QA Lot'. Regression: GET /api/gala/{eid} after PUT /gala {goal:2000} returns goal=2000, raised, count — iter45 gala screen pathway intact.

UI (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): /admin/gala/{eid}/emcee showed emcee-control, emcee-level-500 selected pill, emcee-total 'Paddle total $500 · 1 paddles', emcee-tally '$500\n1 × = $500', emcee-custom/emcee-custom-set/emcee-clear work, pledge-collected-* toggles, emcee-open-screen href=/gala/{eid}. /gala/{eid} shows gala-paddle with gala-paddle-level='$500 hands!' + gala-paddle-count='1 paddles', gala-auction-qr appears when auction is open, and gala-sponsors marquee renders after sponsor upload. GalaExtras in the Sell-tickets drawer exposes gala-emcee-link, gala-auction-link, sponsor-name/sponsor-table/sponsor-file (multipart POST), gala-thanks-toggle (On↔Off), gala-thanks-preview → gala-thanks-frame iframe. /admin/auction/{eid}: ai-title/ai-start/ai-raise/ai-add adds an item, auction-closes + auction-closes-save opens bidding ('Open · 1 items · 0 bidders'), auction-csv visible. /auction/{eid} on mobile: auction-register (auction-reg-name/email/phone/submit) → clears to item view with auction-item-*, auction-amount-* + auction-bid-* → auction-msg 'You're the highest bidder!' and auction-mine-* appears after poll.
action_items: Non-blocking (pre-existing, surfaced during setup): GET /api/admin/events crashes with KeyError 'capacity' if any events row is missing the capacity field. _events_with_counts does e['capacity'] without fallback. Hardening to e.get('capacity', 0) would prevent 500s from legacy or malformed rows.
critical_code_review_comments: server._events_with_counts (line 1956) raises KeyError when a legacy event document lacks 'capacity' (observed with QA-seeded rows). Should be e.get('capacity', 0). This is a stability bug: one bad row 500s the whole admin events listing.

auction_bid: the optimistic lock condition {'id': iid, 'high_bid': i.get('high_bid')} is correct for races; next_min and 'already highest bidder' checks all read before the atomic $set so a lost update returns 409 as spec. ✓

_gala_thanks dedupe uses _push_mark('gala-thanks:{eid}') and gates on event.date == yesterday ET at >= 9am ET; verified end-to-end in subprocess (N1>=1, N2=0 same marker, N3=0 with gala_thanks=False after mark cleared). ✓
_close_auction uses an atomic events.update_one({auction_closed:{'$ne':True}}, {'$set':{auction_closed:True...}}) so a concurrent _auction_loop_close + admin_auction_close only sends emails once. ✓
auction_pay stores session.id BEFORE returning the url. _auction_paid then matches by session_id + status 'unpaid'. The /confirm fallback retrieves the Stripe session to double-check — resilient. ✓
gala_screen aggregates paddle_pledges levels into both raised and paddle.total; correct per the spec.
admin_sponsor_add relies on _store_upload to reject non-images (confirmed via 400 for a text/plain upload). ✓

ThanksToggleIn stores on the event doc (gala_thanks: bool). _gala_recipients + _gala_thanks_html both merge pledges/orders/gifts/wins by lowercased email, keeping unique lines per person (dict.fromkeys). ✓
Minor DX: auction-closes datetime-local field surfaces when state == 'draft' or 'open'. The 'Open bidding' button turns into 'Update time' once open — good UX. ✓
server.py is now 12,127 lines (up ~400 for this iteration). Split overdue (not blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all iter46 selectors verified: emcee-control + emcee-level-500/plus/tally/custom/custom-set/clear/total/open-screen + pledge-collected-*/pledge-undo-*, gala-paddle (gala-paddle-level/count), gala-sponsors, gala-auction-qr, gala-extras (gala-emcee-link, gala-auction-link, sponsor-name/table/file + sponsor-<id> badge, gala-thanks-toggle On↔Off, gala-thanks-preview → gala-thanks-frame), auction-admin (ai-title/start/raise/add, ai-row-*, auction-closes/-save, auction-csv), auction-page (auction-register/reg-name/email/phone/submit, auction-item-*, auction-amount-*, auction-bid-*, auction-msg-*, auction-mine-*).

test_credentials: QA admin cookie session_token=qa_tok_123 via python3 /app/backend/tests/qa_session.py up/down. Brought up and torn down.
seed_data_creation: Transient: one 'QA Iter46 Gala' event (yesterday date) + its paddle pledges, auction item/bidders/bids/win created and torn down by the pytest fixture. One 'QA Iter46 UI Gala' event with +30d date for UI run; its paddle pledges, auction item/bidders/bids/win, sponsor doc, and gala_thanks push_marks were all deleted. qa_session.py down also removed the pre-existing 'QA Gala2' event (title starts with 'QA'); its orphan auction_items/bids/bidders/paddle_pledges were explicitly deleted. /app/memory/.qa_eid removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_gala_paddle_auction_thanks.py; run with 'pytest -n 0' (~10s). The TestThanks test spawns a subprocess that imports server and calls server._gala_thanks(now) with now = event.date+1d 10:00 ET; the test event uses yesterday's date so this does NOT trigger real production thanks. ALL emails go to @example.com (unroutable). qa_session.py 'down' also wipes staff_notify_email + any 'QA*' events, so re-run qa_session.py up before the next admin test. Known pre-existing issue surfaced: GET /api/admin/events 500s with KeyError 'capacity' if a seeded event doc misses the capacity field — ensure your seed inserts set capacity (I used 100). The auction/pay happy-path works even without Stripe live keys because the preview env has stripe test configured; the fixture tolerates a Stripe-not-configured 400 by skipping the paid-status verification.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Pre-existing hardening gap: _events_with_counts does e['capacity'] without defaulting, so legacy/malformed rows return 500. Fix: change line 1956 to e.get('capacity', 0) - 0 - 0. Also means admins can't open /admin?tab=events while a bad event sits in the DB — a per-row try/except would be even safer.
